content.text: Looking at the current code, the issue is clear. The `check_call` function at line 29 uses `if target_host not in approved`. When `approved` is an empty list `[]`, this check passes for any `target_host` because an empty list doesn't contain anything. The fix needs to explicitly block calls when `approved` is empty (meaning the tool shouldn't be called at all).
